_note: B-39. Sign-in log read lever on the mock tenant's signins family file (fixtures/tenant/<client>/signins.json). Mock only; no real Entra sign-in log is called.

levers.name: signins.list
levers.description: Read one user's recent sign-ins (time, app, result code, IP address, location) for the client. Mock of the Entra sign-in log; technician view only.

upn.description: userPrincipalName of one user of this client

limit.description: How many of the newest sign-ins to return (default 10)

impact.L1: A technician sees one person's recent sign-ins, including where they came from; nothing about the person changes, but the IP addresses and places are personal data.
impact.L2: The client's sign-in history is read only by staff scoped to that client, and only for the one user asked about.
impact.L3: Every read is registered, scoped and audited by who asked about whom; the results themselves are not copied into the audit.
impact.L4: Sign-in logs never mix across tenants, and IP addresses and places stay out of prompts, so one office's staff are not profiled.
